structure.label: Bullish structure
structure.explanation: Price is above SMA20/SMA50 and positioned near a recent or 52-week high.

participation.label: Normal participation
participation.explanation: Trading activity is not showing a decisive expansion or contraction.

flow.label: Foreign flow neutral
flow.explanation: Foreign activity does not provide a decisive contextual signal.

liquidity.label: Elevated liquidity risk
liquidity.explanation: One or more execution-quality measures are below the preferred baseline.
